title: Pak Koi Baby Casserole
description: A delicious and comforting casserole dish made with tender pak koi and creamy greek yogurt.
instructions: Cook the casserole according to the package instructions.
In a separate pan, sauté the sweet onion and baby spinach until softened.
Add the pak koi to the pan and cook until tender.
Stir in the greek yogurt and velvety cheese until well combined.
Transfer the mixture to the cooked casserole and top with additional velvety cheese if desired.
Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
